title: Cleaning Up City of San Diego Encampments
description:
Over the last three Fridays, City crews and contractors have connected at least 21 people experiencing homelessness to sheltering options in a three-block area of downtown. 

This targeted operation starts with a compassionate approach: offering available programs and services before crews go in to remove trash and sanitize the area.

This work near K and 17th street happens three days a week, but the City is responding to concerns from nearby businesses and stepping up sheltering and trash-removal efforts. 

Please submit Get It Done reports for unsafe encampments located on City property. Every report is followed up on. While people may return to areas once they are cleaned, crews will be back out again soon to offer sheltering options and sanitize the area. 

#SanDiego
